title: Chat Gateway plugin configuration
description: Discord chat gateway settings. The gateway is INERT until a bot token is set. `token` is writeOnly: the host strips it from every client-facing document. See change: add-chat-gateway.

enabled.description: Master switch. With no token the gateway is inert regardless.

token.description: Discord bot token. SECRET — never returned to a client, never logged.

allowedRoots.description: Mandatory whitelist of directories a session may be spawned in. Empty refuses every spawn. Candidate paths are real-path (symlink) resolved before containment.

fixedMap.description: Fixed channelKey -> cwd map. A binding source, still constrained by allowedRoots.

defaultCwd.description: Preferred cwd when no more specific binding resolves. Still constrained by allowedRoots.

allowlist.description: L1 identity allowlist: Discord user ids permitted to talk to sessions.

admins.description: L2 binding authority: Discord user ids permitted to bind a channel to a cwd.

groupChannels.description: L4: guild channel ids explicitly opted in. Any other guild channel is inert; DMs are isolated.

steerPrefix.description: Prefix forcing delivery:steer for a message arriving mid-turn (default followUp).

editThrottleMs.description: Minimum ms between editMessage calls on one channel (rate-limit guard).

toolPolicy.description: L3 deny-first tool policy enforced in gateway-SPAWNED sessions by the companion guard extension. Attached sessions are owner-trusted and ungated. A tool in neither list is denied unless defaultAction widens it.

approval.description: Tools requiring interactive approval before running.

defaultAction.description: Disposition of a tool named by neither list. Defaults to deny (deny-first).

guardExtension.description: Installed identifier (package name or absolute path) of the companion L3 guard extension. Required for the guard to load into spawned sessions; never invented by the gateway.
